name: Black Forest Fridge Cake
subtitle: A chilled chocolate, cherry, and biscuit dessert
description: A rich no-bake cake layered with chocolate cream, cherries in kirsch, and bourbon biscuits, finished with simple chocolate decoration.

ingredients.preparation: or in the baking section of larger supermarkets)

instructions.text: Lightly oil a suitable cake tin and line it with baking paper, leaving an overhang for lifting out the cake.
Melt the dark chocolate gently in a microwave-safe bowl in short bursts, stirring between each, until smooth. Reserve some for finishing, then let the remainder cool for 10 minutes.
Whisk the double cream, soured cream, icing sugar, vanilla bean paste, and caster sugar until firm peaks form.
Fold the cooled melted chocolate into the cream mixture until evenly combined.
Drain and prepare the cherries as needed. Break the bourbon biscuits into rough pieces and fold them and the cherries through the chocolate cream.
Press the mixture firmly into the lined tin and smooth the surface. Chill until solid enough to slice.
Remove the cake from the tin. Melt any reserved chocolate, spread or drizzle it over the top, and finish with the remaining cherries and a light dusting of icing sugar.
Cut into portions and serve chilled.
